title: macOS Web Simulator
subtitle: This website
description: A full macOS desktop simulator running in the browser — 3D showroom, windowing system, Spotlight, virtual filesystem, Terminal with a real shell, Safari with proxy browsing, live weather, and more. Built with React 19, Three.js, and Tailwind.

title: Vellum
subtitle: Invisible watermarking for IP protection
description: Invisible watermarking system that embeds 64-bit payloads (56-bit metadata + 8-bit CRC8) into text at safe token boundaries. Browser extension (MV3 content script) and registry that anchors Merkle batches to Solana.

title: Origraph
subtitle: Invisible watermarking registry on Solana
description: A registry that anchors Merkle batches of invisible watermarks to the Solana blockchain, providing tamper-proof provenance for IP claims. Split license: Apache-2.0 for the library, AGPL-3.0 for the registry demo.
